suppress.notes: Jetty 9.4.58 shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime-3.5.0 (newest Hadoop release; the jar cannot be re-pinned). It backs Hadoop's own HTTP servers and web clients (NameNode/ResourceManager UIs, WebHDFS), none of which run: Spark local mode uses only Hadoop's FileSystem client for local files.
jline 3.9.0 shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime-3.5.0 (newest Hadoop). The CVEs are in jline's remote telnet/ssh shells and console builtins; Darpan never starts a Hadoop or Spark shell.

commons-configuration2 2.10.1 shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime-3.5.0 (newest Hadoop). Hadoop uses it for metrics2 property files it ships itself; Darpan passes no user-controlled configuration to it.

Jackson 2.18.6 shaded (relocated to org.apache.hadoop.shaded.*) inside hadoop-client-runtime-3.5.0 (newest Hadoop). Hadoop uses it for its REST/JSON client APIs, which local-mode Spark never calls; Darpan's own JSON goes through the framework's unshaded Jackson.

Jetty 12.1.8 shaded (relocated to org.sparkproject.jetty) inside spark-core_2.13-4.2.1; Spark 4.3.0 shades the same version, and a shaded copy cannot be re-pinned from Gradle. Spark uses it only for the web UI and the standalone master/worker HTTP endpoints: Darpan sets spark.ui.enabled=false on every session (guard test) and runs local[*], so no Jetty server starts.

CVE-2018-17190 is Spark standalone cluster mode (an unauthenticated master accepts jobs); there is no fixed version because the fix is configuration. Darpan runs Spark embedded with master local[*]: no standalone master or port exists.

Janino / commons-compiler 3.1.9 (Spark's codegen compiler) CVE-2023-33546: stack overflow when compiling attacker-written Java source. No fixed version exists. Janino only compiles source Spark generates from Darpan's own query plans.
False positive: CVE-2026-111497 is the Python brotli/brotlicffi package and CVE-2026-25087 is pyarrow (Python). Neither affects the Arrow Java jars.
False positive: CVE-2023-37475 is the Go library github.com/hamba/avro, not Apache Avro Java.
False positive: CVE-2017-1000034 is Akka (com.typesafe.akka:akka-actor < 2.4.17). The CPE matcher maps the Scala modules' 2.x/1.x version numbers onto Akka.
False positive: CVE-2021-3918 is the npm package json-schema (prototype pollution), not the Java json-schema-inferrer.

False positive: these CVEs are in Hive server components (hive, hive-exec, hive-service, hive-llap-common). hive-storage-api is only the vectorized column data classes ORC uses; no Hive server, LLAP or query execution is present.
jQuery 1.6.3 bundled as a static asset of Avro IPC's stats web page (StatsServlet). Darpan never starts an Avro IPC server, so the file is never served to a browser.
moment.js inside the Spark web UI's vis-timeline bundle. The UI is disabled on every embedded SparkSession (spark.ui.enabled=false, guarded by SparkClasspathGuardTests), so the file is never served.
